goal: Preserve last-known relay snapshot during quota exhaustion
body: Additional hardening idea: cache the last complete relay_open/claim_list snapshot with fetched_at and registry_head_sha. On GitHub 403, return that snapshot marked stale/degraded instead of failing or appearing empty. This preserves fleet situational awareness during quota exhaustion without pretending freshness.
